notes.title: 30% off Halloween 2020!
notes.content: From October 29, 2020 to November 2, 2020, there is a 30% discount on Halloween! In addition to being cheap, you can also shuttle in 100 secret rooms for endless fun!

notes.title: 发布DLC版本/Publish DLC version
notes.content:
发布DLC版本,增加了更有趣的地道DLC关卡。DLC关卡还可以连接各个普通关卡。祝大家玩的开心！
The release of DLC version adds more interesting tunnel DLC checkpoints. DLC levels can also be connected to ordinary levels. Have a good time!
